research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: InEvent is focusing on developing advanced video editing techniques for live streaming. The technology allows for real-time editing of video streams from remote sources, minimizing latency by utilizing server devices within a cloud network. This innovation is particularly relevant for enhancing the quality and efficiency of virtual and in-person corporate events, meetings, and conferences, aligning with InEvent's core business activities.

overview_description.description:
InEvent is a virtual and hybrid event platform based in Atlanta, USA. InEvent transforms enterprise events with digital technology. Its end-to-end premium solutions simplify training, event, travel, and community management. Each step of a corporate events experience is powered by web, mobile, and APIs that connect stakeholders in a secure, automated, and personalized platform. With worldwide offices, InEvent helps companies see the power of events, one of the world's fastest-growing industries, and enables them to manage their compliance, create award-winning solutions and boost their engagement at events. It has successfully improved more than 6,000 events/year with over 500 clients, collecting more than +60 million streaming minutes in 2020 alone. InEvent offers 24h support, branded scalable platform, transparent pricing, and feature-rich customizable tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Virtual and in-person corporate events, meetings and conferences

product.name: Event Registration
product.description: A platform to create customized event registration forms and workflows, manage approvals, and control waitlists for various event types.

product.name: Badge Printing
product.description: Onsite badge printing service including software, hardware, and support for creating custom badges, wristbands, and NFC tags to streamline event check-in.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows event attendees to access schedules, connect with participants, and receive real-time updates during events.

product.name: Live Studio
product.description: A live streaming platform that delivers studio-quality broadcasts for virtual and hybrid events, supporting live and on-demand content.

product.name: Hybrid Event Production
product.description: A solution to manage hybrid events by combining in-person and virtual sessions, networking, sponsor booths, and breakout rooms in a unified platform.

product.name: Webinars
product.description: A video platform for hosting webinars with features including registration, ticketing, attendance tracking, CRM integration, and audio-video capabilities.
